title: Collection-Service Fee Schedule: Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
## Published collection-service figures — Specimen Collection Appointments

Collection-service figures are published per visit type. The service zone of a visit is the zone of the visit address: at a Patient Service Center (PSC on-site), at a home in service zone 1 (up to 10 road miles of the dispatching PSC), service zone 2 (over 10 to 25 road miles) or service zone 3 (over 25 to 40 road miles), or at a care facility (facility on-site).

| Visit type | Service zones served | Published trip fee by zone (USD) | Additional-patient fee per household member (USD) | Most additional household members per visit | Weekend surcharge (USD) | No trip fee for a certified Medicare-homebound patient |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit | PSC on-site | PSC on-site 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Patient Service Center Scheduled Appointment | PSC on-site | PSC on-site 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Fasting Priority Appointment | PSC on-site | PSC on-site 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Timed Glucose Tolerance Collection | PSC on-site | PSC on-site 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Pediatric Collection Appointment | PSC on-site | PSC on-site 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | No |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | Service zones 1, 2 and 3 | Zone 1: 75.00 · Zone 2: 95.00 · Zone 3: 125.00 | 35.00 | 3 | 35.00 | Yes |
| Facility Bedside Collection Visit | Facility on-site | Facility on-site 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | Yes |

### What each figure is

- **Published trip fee by zone** — the trip fee published for each service zone the visit type serves; Patient Service Center and facility visits map their single zone to 0.00.
- **Additional-patient fee** — the published amount per additional household member collected at the same home visit.
- **Most additional household members** — the maximum number of additional household members per visit.
- **Weekend surcharge** — the published surcharge for a completed visit whose appointment date is a Saturday or Sunday; 0.00 means none.
- **No trip fee for a certified Medicare-homebound patient** — "Yes" means no trip fee is assessed when the patient is certified Medicare-homebound, the collection and travel being billed to Medicare instead.

### Points of reading

- The published zone fees of the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit rise with distance: 75.00 in zone 1, 95.00 in zone 2 and 125.00 in zone 3.
- A home visit may carry at most 3 additional household members; a fourth member is beyond the published maximum.
- Every visit type other than the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit publishes 0.00 for the trip fee, the additional-patient fee and the weekend surcharge.
